lines.en: label futabadorm45:
scene dorm
I knock on Futaba’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，等她回应。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 进来！

lines.en: Rin answers instead.
lines.zh: 开门的却是 Rin。

lines.en: Is this just how things are going to be from now on?
lines.zh: 以后就都要这样了吗？

lines.en: scene black
scene futabagymtwo1
: Yo! What’s up, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哟！怎么了，Sensei？

lines.en: : Hey. Do you know where Futaba is?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你知道 Futaba 在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : Yes sir. I’m actually on my way to meet her now.
lines.zh: : 知道，长官。我正要去找她呢。

lines.en: : She’s at the gym with Nodoka and, if the texts I’m receiving are true, the scary but also hot blonde lady from the last time.
lines.zh: : 她和 Nodoka 在健身房，如果短信没骗我的话，还有上次那个又吓人又火辣的金发大姐也在。

lines.en: : Yumi’s mom.
lines.zh: : Yumi 的妈妈。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo2
: Wait, what? Are you for real?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？你说真的？

lines.en: : Yes. And before you go saying anything about it to Yumi, please be advised that they are not on good terms with one another.
lines.zh: : 真的。不过在你打算跟 Yumi 提这件事之前，先提醒你一句，她们俩关系不太好。

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t really talk to Yumi anyway. But I’ll keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 嗯……反正我也不怎么跟 Yumi 说话。不过我会记住的。

lines.en: : Also, we shouldn’t tell Nodoka about it because she has the hots for her and kind of hates Yumi, so yeah.
lines.zh: : 还有，这事也别告诉 Nodoka，因为她对人家有意思，而且还有点讨厌 Yumi，所以你懂的。

lines.en: : I’ve come to learn that Nodoka has the hots for virtually every single older woman she has met.
lines.zh: : 我已经了解到，Nodoka 对她见过的几乎每一位年长女性都有意思。

lines.en: : I feel that.
lines.zh: : 我懂这种感觉。

lines.en: : Well, I guess I’ll just...head home then.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我就……先回家了。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo3
: You’re not gonna come hang out at the gym with us?
lines.zh: : 你不来健身房跟我们一起玩吗？

lines.en: : Am I “allowed” yet?
lines.zh: : 我现在“被允许”了吗？

lines.en: : Futaba seemed pretty adamant about me not coming.
lines.zh: : Futaba 之前可是相当坚决地表示过不让我去。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo4
: Futaba’s been doing great lately, so I’m sure she won’t mind.
lines.zh: : Futaba 最近状态很好，所以她肯定不会介意的。

lines.en: : You’ve got the Rin stamp of approval for tonight and tonight only, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 你拿到了 Rin 的许可章，仅限今晚哦，Sensei！

lines.en: : Okay, but if I get yelled at, you’re taking the blame.
lines.zh: : 行，但要是有人冲我吼，就全怪你。

lines.en: : Roger that!
lines.zh: : 收到！

lines.en: scene nightsky
Rin and I exit the dorm and begin to make our way over to the gym.
lines.zh: Rin 和我出了宿舍，朝健身房走去。

lines.en: As it turns out, Futaba’s been spending more time there than both her and Nodoka combined ever since the place opened.
lines.zh: 结果发现，自从那家店开张以来，Futaba 待在那儿的时间比她和 Nodoka 加起来还多。

lines.en: Which is impressive, don’t get me wrong...but it sounds slightly worrying for someone who doesn’t have much of a history with exercise.
lines.zh: 说实话这挺了不起的……不过对于一个素来没有运动习惯的人来说，听起来又有点让人担心。

lines.en: I’m in pretty good physical shape and even I can’t fathom being able to handle prolonged exposure to...treadmills or...other exercise things.
lines.zh: 我身体状况还挺好的，可就连我也无法想象自己能长时间忍受……跑步机或者……别的什么健身器材。

lines.en: See? I don’t even know the names of the things. That’s how bad I would be in the gym.
lines.zh: 瞧，我连这些东西的名字都叫不出来。我要是去了健身房得有多糟糕。

lines.en: Either way, I’m glad Futaba seems to be doing well on at least an...attendance level.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我很高兴 Futaba 至少在……出勤率上表现不错。

lines.en: I just hope that she’s not overworking herself.
lines.zh: 我只希望她别把自己练过头。

lines.en: scene black
scene futabagymtwo5
There are 357 chances to go back locked inside the Palace of Versailles’ Hall of Mirrors.
lines.zh: 凡尔赛宫的镜厅里，藏着 357 个回到过去的机会。

lines.en: I wonder how many of them the two of us could stand in front of without feeling out of place.
lines.zh: 我在想，我们两个能在其中多少面镜子前站定，而不觉得自己格格不入。

lines.en: I mean, we are not mirrors of course.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，我们当然不是镜子。

lines.en: So unless they wanted to retitle it the “Hall of Mirrors & People,” which seems unlikely at this point in time, we’d basically be screwed.
lines.zh: 所以，除非他们打算把它改名叫“镜子与人展厅”——这在眼下看来不太可能——那我们基本上就完蛋了。

lines.en: But that’s okay!
lines.zh: 不过没关系！

lines.en: There are mirrors everywhere!
lines.zh: 镜子到处都是！

lines.en: Everywhere we go, we can remind ourselves of the things we either love to see or hate to see!
lines.zh: 无论走到哪里，我们都能借此提醒自己那些我们热爱看到的、或是痛恨看到的东西！

lines.en: Or tolerate seeing!
lines.zh: 或者勉强能看的东西！

lines.en: We even have them built into our phones now!
lines.zh: 现在我们甚至把镜子装进手机里了！

lines.en: We are everywhere, all at once.
lines.zh: 我们无处不在，同时存在于每一个地方。

lines.en: And though many of us hate being followed by ourselves or, as Futaba so artistically mentioned the other day, our {i}shadows{/i}, the rest of us can live peacefully.
lines.zh: 尽管很多人讨厌被自己——或者像 Futaba 前几天说得那么有艺术感的，被“我们的{i}影子{/i}”——跟着，但剩下的人还能平静地活下去。

lines.en: Unfortunately, however, there are people who would go mad in a room with that many mirrors.
lines.zh: 然而不幸的是，有些人若是待在那样一间满是镜子的房间里，是会发疯的。

lines.en: Are you among them?
lines.zh: 你是其中之一吗？

lines.en: Do you enjoy looking at yourself?
lines.zh: 你喜欢看自己吗？

lines.en: If not, what {i}do{/i} you enjoy looking at?
lines.zh: 如果不喜欢，那你{i}喜欢{/i}看什么？

lines.en: Is it something portable?
lines.zh: 是某种可以随身携带的东西吗？

lines.en: Something you could hold in front of your face, so that when you’re forced to stare at your reflection over and over and over again, you won’t want to destroy what you see on the other side?
lines.zh: 某种可以举在脸前的东西——好让你在被迫一遍又一遍地盯着自己的倒影时，不会想把镜子那边的东西砸碎？

lines.en: Personally-
lines.zh: 就我个人而言——

lines.en: I’d like to destroy anything and everything.
lines.zh: 我想毁掉一切，所有的一切。

lines.en: I’d like to destroy all of it so I could rebuild it all again.
lines.zh: 我想把它们通通毁掉，然后再重新建造一遍。

lines.en: Especially that stupid fucking Hall of Mirrors because 357 is an idiotic number and should have been rounded up to 360 or something.
lines.zh: 尤其是那该死的镜厅，因为 357 这个数字蠢透了，本来应该凑成 360 什么的。

lines.en: I think 365 would be better, though.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得 365 更好。

lines.en: That way, you could stare into a new mirror every single day of the year-
lines.zh: 那样的话，一年里的每一天，你都可以盯着一面新的镜子——

lines.en: And still look absolutely hideous.
lines.zh: 然后依然丑得惨不忍睹。

lines.en: Except for leap years, obviously.
lines.zh: 当然，闰年除外。

lines.en: On leap years, you’d get an extra day to do whatever you want.
lines.zh: 闰年的时候，你会多出一天，想干什么就干什么。

lines.en: A day where mirrors or pictures don’t exist.
lines.zh: 那一天，镜子和照片都不存在。

lines.en: Where everything in the world is entirely up to perception and can not be visually checked by others.
lines.zh: 世界上的一切都只取决于感知，无法被他人用眼睛检验。

lines.en: It would all be exactly as we want it to be, and we’d never have to face the truth of what it {i}actually{/i} is.
lines.zh: 一切都和我们期望的一模一样，我们也永远不必去面对它{i}真实{/i}的样子。

lines.en: Do you understand?
lines.zh: 你明白吗？

lines.en: No?
lines.zh: 不明白？

lines.en: Well, fuck you then.
lines.zh: 那去你的吧。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo6
: Futaba?...
lines.zh: : Futaba？……

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo7
: What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. All I did was say hi and she started freaking the fuck out.
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道。我就打了个招呼，她就开始发疯了。

lines.en: : She ain’t on drugs or some shit, is she? Not really sure how to handle this.
lines.zh: : 她不会是嗑了什么药吧？我真不知道该怎么处理这种事。

lines.en: : I’m fine! Just...Just give me a minute!
lines.zh: : 我没事！只是……只要给我一分钟！

lines.en: : Take as much time as you need. No one’s rushing you.
lines.zh: : 慢慢来，不用急。没人催你。

lines.en: : She’s not on drugs. Seeing you probably just...surprised her.
lines.zh: : 她没嗑药。可能只是看见你……吓了一跳。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo8
: Shit, dude! I ain’t {i}that{/i} intimidating, am I?
lines.zh: : 操，老兄！我有{i}那么{/i}吓人吗？

lines.en: : Sensei...please go home!
lines.zh: : Sensei……请你回去吧！

lines.en: : Futaba...
lines.zh: : Futaba……

lines.en: : It’s not that. She’s probably just...feeling reminded of something she didn’t want to be reminded of.
lines.zh: : 不是那样的。她大概是……被勾起了什么不想被勾起的回忆。

lines.en: : We’re going to need a better explanation than that if we’re going to be able to understand...
lines.zh: : 我们要想理解的话，你得说得再清楚点……

lines.en: : Yeah. The fuck is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 对啊。这他妈算什么意思？

lines.en: : I’ve never even said a word to the fuckin’ girl. The hell would she be reminded of?
lines.zh: : 我他妈连一句话都没跟那丫头说过。她能想起什么来？

lines.en: : Your daughter.
lines.zh: : 你女儿。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo9
: I told you to go home!
lines.zh: : 我叫你回去！

lines.en: : Which I would happily do if you weren’t having a nervous breakdown.
lines.zh: : 如果你不是在精神崩溃，我早就高高兴兴地回去了。

lines.en: : I’m just stressed! It’s not a breakdown!
lines.zh: : 我只是压力大而已！才不是崩溃！

lines.en: : Her daughter?
lines.zh: : 她女儿？

lines.en: : Yumi? She do something to this girl?
lines.zh: : Yumi？她对这丫头做了什么？

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo10
: Yumi?...
lines.zh: : Yumi？……

lines.en: : The fuck did she do that would make a girl break down like that out of fuckin’ nowhere?
lines.zh: : 她到底他妈干了什么，能让一个女孩毫无征兆地崩成这样？

lines.en: : You are making everything worse! Go home!
lines.zh: : 你只会让事情变得更糟！回去！

lines.en: : You’re...Yumi’s mom?
lines.zh: : 你是……Yumi 的妈妈？

lines.en: : In name only at this point. Hasn’t said a word to me in years.
lines.zh: : 现在只是名义上的了。她已经好几年没跟我说过一句话。

lines.en: : Yeah, that kind of...has a lot to do with what happened.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这也和发生的事有很大关系。

lines.en: : You were brought up and Yumi kind of exploded on Futaba here.
lines.zh: : 当时提到你，Yumi 就冲着 Futaba 爆发了。

lines.en: : Which, by itself probably would have been okay, but she’s been tormenting her for the entire[school] year.
lines.zh: : 单是那样或许还不要紧，可她已经整整折磨了她一个[school]年了。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo11
: Do you think this is helping?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这么说有用吗？

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo12
scene futabagymtwo11
: I don’t know. But there’s not really anything else I can do.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。但我也没有别的办法了。

lines.en: : It’s not like Yumi’s going to stop on her own. And you’re already freaking out, so there’s no harm in just airing out all of the dirty laundry while we’re still in the thick of things.
lines.zh: : Yumi 又不会自己停手。而你已经崩溃了，所以趁着事情还没过去，干脆把脏衣服全抖出来，也没什么损失。

lines.en: : I’m going to be sick.
lines.zh: : 我要吐了。

lines.en: : The fuck you mean “tormenting” her? How’d I even come up in the first place?
lines.zh: : “折磨”你他妈是什么意思？我又是怎么扯进来的？

lines.en: : You just...did. It wasn’t really a calculated decision or anything.
lines.zh: : 就是……扯进来了。真不是什么精心算计过的决定之类的。

lines.en: : And that alone was enough to make her blow up?
lines.zh: : 光是这样就足以让她炸了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But, like I said, this has been going on for a while and-
lines.zh: : 是的。不过就像我说的，这事已经持续一段时间了，而且——

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo13
: Hey...uhh...Futaba, was it?
lines.zh: : 嘿……呃……你叫 Futaba，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m not really that good at this...apology shit...but I’m sorry for whatever my fucking shithead daughter said to you.
lines.zh: : 我其实不太擅长……道歉这套……不过我为我那个混账女儿对你说的那些话道歉。

lines.en: : You...don’t have to...
lines.zh: : 你……不用这样……

lines.en: : Nah, I kinda do. Even if she doesn’t talk to me, I’m a lot of the reason she wound up the way she did.
lines.zh: : 不，我得这样。就算她不跟我说话，她变成今天这样，我也有很大责任。

lines.en: : So I’m not askin’ you to forgive her or try to be her friend or any of that shit...I just want you to know that she’s a prick and that...she’ll just do shit like that sometimes.
lines.zh: : 所以我不是要你原谅她，也不是要你试着跟她做朋友什么的……我只是想让你知道，她就是个混蛋，而且……她有时候就是会干出这种事。

lines.en: : It runs in the family, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概是遗传吧。

lines.en: : Oh...uhh...okay...
: Great. So, now that everything is back to normal-
lines.zh: : 很好。那么，既然一切都恢复正常了——

lines.en: scene black
Futaba gets off of the workout bench thing (Still have no idea what the proper name is) and immediately approaches me.
lines.zh: Futaba 从那个卧推凳之类的东西上下来（我还是不知道它到底叫什么），径直朝我走来。

lines.en: Yuki and Nodoka quickly back off and I’m suddenly dealing with this on my own...
lines.zh: Yuki 和 Nodoka 迅速退开，我突然就得独自面对这件事了……

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo14
: Back to normal?
lines.zh: : 恢复正常？

lines.en: : It wasn’t enough to come to the one place you {i}know{/i} I’m not comfortable with you seeing me in...You had to tell Yumi’s mom about what happened as well? Even when I told you not to?
lines.zh: : 跑到你{i}明知{/i}我不愿意让你看到我的地方来还不够……你还非得把发生的事告诉 Yumi 的妈妈？哪怕我明确说过不要？

lines.en: : And then once you’re done you say everything is “back to normal?”
lines.zh: : 然后等你说完，你还说一切都“恢复正常了”？

lines.en: : Are you kidding?
lines.zh: : 你在开玩笑吗？

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo15
: I...deserve some of the blame too.
lines.zh: : 我……也有错。

lines.en: : He was going to go home and...I invited him to come hang out here with us.
lines.zh: : 他本来要回家的……是我邀请他来这儿跟我们一起玩。

lines.en: : Even though you knew I didn’t want him here?
lines.zh: : 尽管你知道我不想让他来？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I just thought you’d been doing a great job lately and...that you might change your mind if he was actually here.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你最近做得很好……而且如果他真的在这儿，你也许会改变主意。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo16
: Well...that still doesn’t change anything.
lines.zh: : 那也改变不了什么。

lines.en: : Sensei should have known better.
lines.zh: : Sensei 本该更懂事才对。

lines.en: : But apparently Sensei cares more about {i}observing{/i} my issues than he does actually helping me with them now.
lines.zh: : 但显然，比起真正帮我解决问题，Sensei 现在更在意的只是{i}旁观{/i}我的问题。

lines.en: : I really didn’t mean any harm.
lines.zh: : 我真的没有恶意。

lines.en: : Yes you did...
lines.zh: : 你有……

lines.en: : Futaba-
lines.zh: : Futaba——

lines.en: : No. Don’t say another word.
lines.zh: : 不。别再说了。

lines.en: : Just because I opened up to you about my...disorder doesn’t mean I want you neck deep in all of my problems, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我向你坦白了我的……病症，不代表我就想让你一头扎进我所有的问题里，Sensei。

lines.en: : Stop getting involved in every single aspect of my life and let me do what I need to do to get better.
lines.zh: : 别再插手我生活的每一个角落了，让我用自己的方式好起来。

lines.en: : Now, go home. I don’t want you here.
lines.zh: : 现在，回家吧。我不想你在这儿。

lines.en: : Sorry again, Futaba...
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉，Futaba……

lines.en: : I’ll deal with you later, Rin. I just want to get back to working out and...forget this whole freakout even happened.
lines.zh: : Rin，我回头再找你算账。我现在只想继续锻炼……然后把刚才这场失态忘掉。

lines.en: scene black
I somehow manage to bite my tongue (Something I’m not very good at) and head home.
lines.zh: 我总算忍住没开口（这我可不太擅长），然后回了家。

lines.en: I wish I had more to say about why I just...kept going despite being told to stop-
lines.zh: 我真希望对于自己为什么在被叫停之后……还一意孤行，能说出更多理由——

lines.en: But I guess it really just comes down to something I already know about myself.
lines.zh: 但归根结底，大概还是那个我早就知道的、关于我自己的事实。

lines.en: I’m the worst.
lines.zh: 我是最差劲的。

lines.en: I don’t need any fancy words or poetic prose to showcase that.
lines.zh: 我不需要什么花哨的辞藻或诗意的句子来证明这一点。

lines.en: Just a few actions that seem small to me, but gigantic to someone else.
lines.zh: 只需要几个在我看来微不足道、对别人来说却巨大无比的举动。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
I lie in my bed after microwaving the dinner Ami left out for me, unsure of whether or not I want to go to sleep now or spend the next hour or two browsing the Internet for porn.
lines.zh: 我把 Ami 给我留的晚饭微波热了热，之后躺在床上，拿不定主意是现在就睡，还是接下来一两个小时上网找点片子看。

lines.en: What I’d prefer is to wallow in self-pity and beat myself up over getting involved in something I shouldn’t have bothered with-
lines.zh: 我更想沉浸在自怨自艾里，为自己插手了本不该管的事而狠狠自责——

lines.en: But that just doesn’t seem possible right now.
lines.zh: 但这会儿似乎做不到。

lines.en: I don’t feel anything.
lines.zh: 我什么都感觉不到。

lines.en: I’m too busy thinking of mirrors.
lines.zh: 我满脑子都是镜子。

lines.en: : Umm...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : Uhh...Futaba is here to see you?
lines.zh: : 呃……Futaba 来找你？

lines.en: : Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: : Yeah...I invited her in but, she says it will only take a second and that she’d rather stay outside.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我请她进来了，可她说只要一下下，而且更想待在外面。

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 哈。

lines.en: scene black
I get off the bed and head to the front door.
lines.zh: 我下床走向玄关。

lines.en: Ami tries to follow me to see what's going on, but I wave her off and she heads into her room as I make my way outside...
lines.zh: Ami 想跟出来看看怎么回事，但我挥手让她回去，于是她回了自己房间，我则走了出去……

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo17
: Hey.
: So...umm...
: I wanted to...apologize for how I acted before.
lines.zh: : 我想……为之前的态度道歉。

lines.en: Weakling.
lines.zh: 弱者。

lines.en: : I know you wouldn’t do anything to purposely hurt me and...I’m sorry for telling you not to get involved when...I’m sure you were just trying to help.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不会故意做什么伤害我的事……而且……很抱歉我让你别插手，明明……我相信你只是想帮忙。

lines.en: : I’ve just been...overworking myself lately and...so many things happening at once got to me.
lines.zh: : 我只是最近……把自己逼得太紧了……一下子发生太多事，我就受不了了。

lines.en: : It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没关系。

lines.en: : I’m just a little surprised since I figured I was going to have to be the one to apologize to you.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点意外，因为我以为该道歉的人是我。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo18
: I mean...that...would be kind of nice...
lines.zh: : 那个……那……倒也挺好的……

lines.en: : Since you sort of...did exactly what I told you not to do...twice.
lines.zh: : 毕竟你算是……把我明确说不要做的事做了……还做了两次。

lines.en: : The first one should be excused because it was Rin who invited me. Just assume I was going there to hang out with her.
lines.zh: : 第一次情有可原，因为是 Rin 邀请我的。你就当我去那儿是找她玩的。

lines.en: : Nice try, but...she already told me that you asked for me when you showed up at the dorm.
lines.zh: : 想得美，不过……她已经告诉我了，你一到宿舍就问起了我。

lines.en: : Then she has betrayed both of us today and can not be trusted any longer.
lines.zh: : 那她今天就背叛了我们两个人，从此不可再信。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo19
: Heheh...if that’s true, then the only person I can still trust is Nodoka. And she’s...still a little shaken up by discovering her latest crush is Yumi’s mom.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……如果真是这样，那我唯一还能信任的就只有 Nodoka 了。而她……发现自己最新的暗恋对象竟然是 Yumi 的妈妈，到现在还有点没缓过来。

lines.en: : She’ll get over it the second another older woman walks by.
lines.zh: : 等下一个年长女性从她身边走过，她立马就没事了。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo18
: Probably...
lines.zh: : 大概吧……

lines.en: : But...yeah...
: I just wanted you to know that...I didn’t {i}entirely{/i} mean everything I said to you at the gym tonight.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你知道……今晚在健身房我对你说的那些话，并不{i}全{/i}是真心的。

lines.en: : Yes, I do wish you’d be less involved in...certain aspects of my life...
lines.zh: : 是的，我确实希望你少插手我生活里的……某些方面……

lines.en: : But that thing about how you care more about observing my issues than helping me was...uncalled for.
lines.zh: : 但说你更在意旁观我的问题、而不是帮我解决，那句话……说得太过分了。

lines.en: : Well, thanks.
lines.zh: : 行吧，谢谢。

lines.en: : But next time, wait a little longer before coming to apologize.
lines.zh: : 不过下次，要来道歉的话，先多等一会儿。

lines.en: : There’s no point in saying anything mean to anyone if you’re just going to backtrack as soon as it happens.
lines.zh: : 既然话一出口就要立刻收回，那当初说那些难听的话又有什么意义。

lines.en: : I...think you’re overestimating how mean I want to be...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得你把我想得比实际更坏了……

lines.en: : You should know by now that...that isn’t the kind of person I am.
lines.zh: : 你现在应该知道了……我不是那种人。

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : You’re the kind of person who walks across town to apologize for something {i}I{/i} did when you could have just called or sent me a text.
lines.zh: : 你是那种会为了{i}我{/i}做的事穿过整座城来道歉的人，明明打个电话或者发条短信就行。

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo20
: Well...I also wanted to...see you, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也想……见你，所以……

lines.en: : I’ll go home now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在要回去了。

lines.en: : Do you want me to walk you back?
lines.zh: : 要我送你回去吗？

lines.en: scene futabagymtwo21
: No...it’s okay. I’ll probably stop at the convenience store for coffee along the way or something...
lines.zh: : 不……没事。路上我可能会顺便去便利店买杯咖啡什么的……

lines.en: : It’s like...10:00 PM.
lines.zh: : 现在都……十点了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...I’m suddenly in the mood to...try writing something.
lines.zh: : 嗯，可是……我突然很想……试着写点东西。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. Overworking yourself mentally because overworking yourself {i}physically{/i} wasn’t quite enough.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊。把自己{i}身体{/i}逼得还不够，还要在精神上再逼一把。

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : But at least I know...you and everyone else will wind up swooping in to save the day or something if I...work too hard again.
lines.zh: : 但至少我知道……如果我再把自己逼得太狠，你和其他人总会冲出来拯救世界之类的。

lines.en: : So...yeah.
lines.zh: : 所以……嗯。

lines.en: : I’m sorry again and...goodnight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉……晚安，Sensei。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Futaba。

lines.en: scene black
Sometimes, people apologize just so they can hold onto things they’re afraid of losing.
lines.zh: 有时候，人们道歉只是为了抓住那些他们害怕失去的东西。

lines.en: I feel like tonight was one of those nights.
lines.zh: 我觉得今晚就是这样的夜晚。
